query: Consider the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement between Bosch and Automotive Service Solutions; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold:
Confidentiality obligations shall survive termination of this Agreement for the Period of Confidentiality set forth above unless the Confidential Information is a trade secret, in which case the confidentiality obligations shall continue for as long as the information is a trade secret.
Sections 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 17, 18, 19 and any sections (or parts thereof) which, by their nature, are intended to survive termination shall survive termination of this Agreement.
rag_answer: Yes. Section 19 (“Survival”) states that Sections 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 17, 18, 19 and any sections or parts thereof which, by their nature, are intended to survive termination shall survive termination of the Agreement. Section 3 also states that confidentiality obligations survive termination for the Period of Confidentiality, and for trade secrets they continue for as long as the information remains a trade secret.
